name: The Langley, A Luxury Collection Hotel
positioning: The Langley, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Buckinghamshire: a restored Palladian-style former manor home of the third Duke of Marlborough, set in Capability Brown-designed gardens in the Buckinghamshire countryside, a short car or train journey from central London
best_for: Travelers wanting a historic country-estate stay within easy reach of London
Families wanting connecting rooms and suites

facts.text: The hotel is set in the former manor home of the third Duke of Marlborough.
Rooms and suites are in the sensitively restored Palladian-style mansion house and the adjoining Grade II-listed Brew House.
The rooms and suites were designed by Dennis Irvine studio.
Baroque fireplaces and ornate doorways have been re-established in the main house.
Rooms in the Brew House, a Grade II-listed outbuilding, reflect former owners who brewed their own ferments.
The hotel has an indoor and an outdoor pool, a thermal area and fitness programs.
Each room includes access to the spa thermal facilities and gym.
The spa's thermal facilities and custom treatments are influenced by the restorative properties of the surrounding Buckinghamshire countryside.
The spa has authentic hammams where body rituals are performed.
Cedar, the fine-dining restaurant, serves European cuisine with Spanish, French and Italian influences, using ingredients from local suppliers.
Afternoon tea is served in the Drawing Room; it and Cedar have terraces overlooking the lake and estate grounds.
Connecting rooms and suites suit families, with children's robes, slippers and bathroom amenities.

highlights.text: The Duke of Marlborough Suite, the former room of the third Duke, overlooks the grounds and the lake, with an adjoining living room, three bedrooms and Athenian marble bathrooms.
The Grade II-listed gardens were re-designed in the 18th century by Lancelot 'Capability' Brown.
The spa's private VIP Suite has a relaxation space, vitality pool, juniper sauna and amethyst crystal steam room.
Rooms feature roll-top baths, and expansive suites have grand windows.
Through expert partners, the concierge can arrange falconry, horse riding in Windsor Great Park and polo lessons.

considerations.text: The hotel is in Langley Park in the Buckinghamshire countryside, a short car or train journey from central London rather than in the city itself.
Rooms are split between the Main House, with restored Baroque fireplaces, and the Brew House outbuilding, which has its own character.
